posts.title: Status codes your API is getting wrong
posts.description: The HTTP method is half of your API's contract. The status code is the other half. Here are the codes that get misused most, and why it matters more now that AI agents are calling your API.

posts.title: Naming my Strava runs from Garmin with a Drupal webhook
posts.description: My Garmin runs sync to Strava with generic names like "Lunch Run." I built a Strava webhook in Drupal that renames them with the Garmin workout name and adds the workout plan to the description, working through it with Claude Code in one afternoon.

posts.title: ContribKanban now tracks GitLab work items
posts.description: Drupal projects are moving their issues from Drupal.org to GitLab work items, and ContribKanban couldn't see them. I rebuilt it so that one board tracks both.
